summary.name: Numi
summary.one_liner: Numi is a text-based calculator app for Mac that lets you type math expressions and see results instantly.
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Numi as a beautiful text calculator for Mac. It is localized into English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Traditional Chinese and Korean. The page offers a download and links to an end user license agreement. It also has an email field for notifications about new features and releases. The page text does not describe specific calculation features in detail.
notable: Listed in an open-source Mac apps collection
caveats: Page does not state pricing or whether it is free or paid
Feature details are not described on the page
